summary: Accepted for host curation. All 39 and only the initial audit's incorrect temporal claim IDs are repaired by 54 exact operations: 30 Tang Wude 3 / same-day chronology containers are narrowed from AD 620-621 to AD 620; six biography-heading claims become explicit undated name attestations; and the undated \u5352\u5b98 death-in-office statement, Fan Ye literary citation, and Shubao martial appraisal become explicit undated attestations. The 15 active-date-hint changes remove only the dependent invented interval language and retain separately supported AD 620, AD 621, and AD 622 hints. No new dates, endpoints, persons, names, mentions, relationships, or prose are introduced.
